# Extract user-visible strings that might still be jargon
rg -n --glob '!usability/**' 'title=|"|>[^<]*(algorithm|simplified|Fréchet|Frechet|Baseline|Candidate|path shortener|tolerance|orig\.|Compression|Metric|Load Trace|search |stream |classic |LSSD|PED|prefix|segment start|alive|anchor)[^<]*<' web/index.html 2>/dev/null | head -60

# Also check visible text / titles in index for remaining issues
rg -n 'title="[^"]*"' web/index.html | head -100

# Check for "methods" vs leftover jargon, and any "Select" / "Choose" inconsistencies
rg -n -i 'user-facing|innerHTML|textContent|setBaselineStatus|title:|aria-label|Instructions|hint' web/viewer.js | head -5

# Look at recent pattern - what might still lag
rg -n 'title=|"[^"]*(as-you-go|all-at-once|keep %|Gray path|green path|Match|Grid|Option|Segment|Step)' web/index.html | head -40

# Find remaining novice-unfriendly patterns in live UI strings only
python3 << 'PY'
import re, pathlib
files = [pathlib.Path('web/index.html'), pathlib.Path('web/viewer.js')]
patterns = [
    r'shortens the path',
    r'original trajectory',
    r'the original',
    r'simplif',
    r'algorithm',
    r'Candidate(?! markers)',
    r'Baseline',
    r'Load Trace',
    r'path shortener',
    r'search spacing',
    r'search options',
    r'the search',
    r'being processed',
    r'Fréchet|Frechet',
    r'Compression',
    r'Metric\b',
    r'Alive',
    r'anchor',
    r'prefix',
    r'streaming',
    r'classic',
    r'\bstream\b',
    r'looking for',
    r'Match tolerance',
    r'distance budget',
    r'match error',
    r'keep ratio',
    r'Paths & search',
    r'landing zone',
    r'Still-allowed',
    r'Candidate region',
    r'Original path',
    r'Path so far',
    r'Full result',
    r'Search circle',
    r'next simplified',
    r'simplified path',
    r'simplified piece',
    r'path step',
    r'still being considered',
    r'ruled out',
]
for f in files:
    text = f.read_text()
    # strip comments roughly
    print(f'=== {f} ===')
    for pat in patterns:
        for m in re.finditer(pat, text, re.I):
            # get line
            start = text.rfind('\n', 0, m.start()) + 1
            end = text.find('\n', m.end())
            line = text[start:end].strip()
            # skip code identifiers / comments that aren't user facing
            if line.startswith('//') or line.startswith('*') or 'function ' in line[:40]:
                continue
            if any(x in line for x in ['const ', 'let ', 'var ', 'BASELINE', 'algorithm =', 'data.algorithm', 'state.', 'el("', 'id=', 'class=', 'toggle-', 'headerBaseline', 'baseline', 'candidateIdx', 'candidateInput', 'mobileCandidate', 'accordionBaseline', 'compareFrechet', 'FRECHET', 'frechet/', 'computedFrechet', 'startFrechet', 'plainUserError', 'simplifiedLen', 'simplified?', '.simplified', 'msg.simplified', 'parsed.simplified', 'toggle-simplified', 'prefixes', 'prefixBack', 'prefixForward']):
                # still show if it's clearly a title/aria/textContent string
                if not any(k in line for k in ['title=', 'aria-', 'textContent', 'innerHTML', 'setBaselineStatus', 'alert(', 'uploadStatus', 'return "', "return '", '`"']):
                    continue
            lineno = text[:m.start()].count('\n') + 1
            print(f'{lineno}: [{pat}] {line[:160]}')
PY
